clarification_resolved.decision: OQ-03: This codebase launches codex via command submission (submitAgentCommand -> SessionInputGateway -> SessionManager.writeInput), not at session creation (createSession spawns a shell only). Detection/injection point resolved to writeInput's codex command-submission path, reusing existing detectForegroundAppHint (codex executable token). createSession never sees a codex command; injecting there would be hollow. Non-codex sessions unchanged; config default off.

SessionManager: runtimeSessionConfig gains codexTuiSuppression, read in constructor via structural cast (SessionConfig interface in config.types.ts is out of plan files[], so cast avoids touching a 3rd file). Module-level CODEX_TUI_SUPPRESSION_FLAGS + pure injectCodexTuiSuppressionFlags(command) inserting -c flags after the executable token (before subcommand). writeInput calls new private maybeInjectCodexTuiSuppression(input, submittedCommand, hintedAppId, hasEnter) before pty.write: rewrites only when config on + hintedAppId==='codex' + full-line atomic submission (guards partial keystrokes); detection/tracking (submittedCommand, aiTuiLaunchAttempt, notifyCommandSubmitted) stay on the original command.
